description: Source code implementing UART shell backend for Zephyr OS, including UART event handling, buffer management, and shell initialization.

methods.name: async_callback
methods.description: Handles UART asynchronous events such as transmission completion, data ready, buffer requests, and buffer releases.

methods.name: uart_rx_handle
methods.description: Processes incoming UART data, manages ring buffer, and signals shell thread when data is available.

methods.name: uart_dtr_check
methods.description: Checks the Data Terminal Ready (DTR) signal status for flow control.

methods.name: dtr_timer_handler
methods.description: Timer handler to check DTR signal and enable UART transmission when active.

methods.name: uart_tx_handle
methods.description: Handles UART data transmission from ring buffer, manages DTR flow control.

methods.name: uart_callback
methods.description: UART interrupt callback handling RX and TX readiness.

methods.name: irq_init
methods.description: Initializes UART interrupt handling, ring buffers, and DTR timer.

methods.name: rx_enable
methods.description: Enables UART reception with specified buffer and length.

methods.name: async_init
methods.description: Initializes UART asynchronous reception.

methods.name: polling_rx_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles polling-based UART reception timeout, reads data via polling.

methods.name: polling_init
methods.description: Initializes polling-based UART reception.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes UART shell transport with selected API (async, interrupt-driven, or polling).

methods.name: irq_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes UART interrupt handling.

methods.name: async_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes UART async reception.

methods.name: polling_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes polling UART reception.

methods.name: uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes UART shell transport.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables UART transport with optional blocking transmission.

methods.name: polling_write
methods.description: Writes data via polling method.

methods.name: irq_write
methods.description: Writes data via interrupt-driven method.

methods.name: async_write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Main write function selecting method based on configuration.

methods.name: irq_read
methods.description: Reads data via interrupt-driven method.

methods.name: polling_read
methods.description: Reads data via polling method.

methods.name: async_read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Main read function selecting method based on configuration.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes SMP shell data (if enabled).

methods.name: enable_shell_uart
methods.description: Initializes and enables the shell UART device at system startup.
